title: A Clear and Feasible Day
goal: Turn known commitments into a realistic day without inventing calendar access.
finish: Return priorities, time conflicts and one useful next action; do not create reminders by implication.

title: A Week That Fits
goal: Choose a feasible week and preserve a simple restart point.
finish: Return a capacity-aware plan, deferred work and a concise continuation note.

title: From Lecture to Retrieval
goal: Turn permitted learning sources into a study map and a checked practice session.
finish: Return traceable study material and actual-attempt feedback, not a claim of mastery.

title: From Confusion to Explanation
goal: Identify a specific learning gap and check understanding in a new example.
finish: Return the repaired distinction and an answered or clearly pending transfer question.

title: A Source-Grounded Answer
goal: Investigate a bounded question and audit the resulting claims.
finish: Return a supported conclusion, exact evidence locations and the remaining uncertainty.

title: Investigate Competing Accounts
goal: Compare the strongest plausible explanations without prematurely choosing a story.
finish: Return discriminating evidence and the smallest next observation, not speculative certainty.

title: A Verified Small Repair
goal: Reproduce an owned-code defect, repair it and inspect the changed behavior.
finish: Return the narrow patch and real regression results; preserve any unrun integration checks.

title: Review a Candidate for Delivery
goal: Evaluate an exact candidate against its real acceptance criteria.
finish: Return source-bound findings, artifact checks and a scoped delivery decision without publishing.

title: A Coherent Creative Sequence
goal: Turn a concrete creative brief into a timed sequence with continuity rules.
finish: Return a usable shot plan and inspect any actual supplied or generated frames; label text-only boards honestly.

title: Finish a Creative Deliverable
goal: Revise a draft within the brief and verify its requested output form.
finish: Return the actual deliverable where tools permit, otherwise a precisely labeled production plan.

title: Test an Idea Before Promising It
goal: Identify a customer assumption and shape a bounded offer around supported needs.
finish: Return a testable offer and evidence-gathering step, with no invented demand or sent outreach.

title: Improve a Repeated Operation
goal: Find operational friction, prioritize a repair and define a recoverable process.
finish: Return a bounded improvement backed by available records and worked exception cases.

title: From Raw Records to a Defensible Answer
goal: Check a dataset, perform a reproducible analysis and communicate its meaning.
finish: Return an inspected analysis with source definitions, calculations and honest uncertainty.

title: A Fair Candidate Comparison
goal: Prepare a valid dataset and compare model candidates under frozen conditions.
finish: Return executed per-case evidence or a clearly unrun comparison packet; never substitute setup for results.

title: A Truthful Application Story
goal: Map an actual work record to a role and produce credible application material.
finish: Return role-relevant evidence and finished prose without inventing experience or submitting automatically.

title: Prepare a Consequential Conversation
goal: Clarify terms, draft a clear message and prepare for an honest exchange.
finish: Return priorities, a complete draft and realistic tradeoffs; leave sending and commitments to the user.

title: A Practical Personal Plan
goal: Scope a personal project and check it against actual constraints.
finish: Return a manageable plan with dependencies, costs or access uncertainties and a fallback.

title: A Feedback-Rich Hobby Session
goal: Choose a small exercise, inspect the attempt and decide what to practice next.
finish: Return an achievable exercise and feedback grounded in the actual attempt.

title: Organize Questions and Practical Support
goal: Prepare for a professional conversation and coordinate logistics without changing the professional plan.
finish: Return a factual question list and privacy-scoped support handoff, not diagnosis or treatment advice.

title: A Routine That Respects the Person
goal: Make a personal routine accessible and test a small change without pressure.
finish: Return a person-directed routine, fallback and optional review prompt with no unsolicited scheduling.

title: From Product Contract to Verified Handoff
goal: Turn a bounded product request into interface, data and automation contracts that an existing implementation owner can execute.
finish: Deliver the inert dependency review, declared state graph, schema-risk report and exact remaining implementation/release checks; never claim deployment.

title: Reconcile a Data Pipeline Before Delivery
goal: Review schema evolution, reconcile a versioned batch and inspect a supplied query plan without modifying a production database.
finish: Return the schema decision, reconciled candidate state, conflict ledger and query-plan evidence; retain production transaction and retention obligations.
input_contract: Prior state and source event batch

title: From Tokens and States to Interface QA
goal: Measure supplied color pairs, find missing interaction states and review target observations before actual rendered-interface acceptance.
finish: Return contrast calculations, graph gaps and eligible locator candidates; report browser, keyboard and visual checks only when they actually ran.

title: From Incident Records to a Bounded Recovery Handoff
goal: Reconstruct the incident, calculate its service budget and size a measured capacity hypothesis while preserving original response authority.
finish: Return the dated incident timeline, event-ratio budget and capacity calculation with hypotheses, observed effects and a precise next authorized action.

title: Prepare an Automation Without Losing Control of Effects
goal: Check a dependency plan, review unique observed targets and reconcile uncertain prior operations before handing off to the existing executor.
finish: Return a source-bound execution proposal and concrete blockers; do not dispatch, authenticate supplied evidence or authorize retries.
